faqs.a: Choose a bag and tap Order on WhatsApp. A message with the bag, its price and its link opens in WhatsApp. Send it, and Heiz Bags will reply to confirm. You can also add several bags to your basket and send them in one message.
Ask us on WhatsApp when you send your order.
Our pick-up point is at {shops}, opposite Ambassadeur Hotel, Nairobi. In our words: "You will find the bags already available there." See the Find us page for directions.

faqs.q: Can I return or exchange a bag?
Can I see a bag before I buy it?
faqs.a: Yes. Visit our pick-up point to see bags in person. Send a WhatsApp message first if you would like to check that a particular bag is there.
Yes. In Heiz Bags' words: "Deliveries are done countrywide at a small fee." Tell us where you are on WhatsApp and Heiz Bags will advise.

faqs.q: Are the bags on the website in stock?
faqs.a: Ask on WhatsApp to confirm. Heiz Bags will confirm availability when you send your order.
Yes. The Heiz laptop handbag fits up to a 14-inch laptop and has a padded laptop compartment. Ask on WhatsApp about the colours available now.
